description: Former LuzAir Lockheed L-1011-500 TriStar, construction number 293A-1248, bought by the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority after several years parked at King Hussein International Airport and sunk on 26 August 2019 off the old phosphate port beside the King Abdullah Reef dive site, at 15 to 28 m. Hazardous materials were stripped beforehand. Spottingmode tracks the same airframe from stored at Aqaba to submerged and reconfirmed it in September 2022.
